ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a transition-state structure; on the left, a heteroaromatic ring containing two nitrogen atoms fused with the middle aromatic ring can be seen; on the right, a bridged-ring amine structure connected/fused to this aromatic part can be seen, and the amine nitrogen is further connected to the right to a side chain containing a hydroxyl group. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows; hydrogen-related bonds are also not counted. Then reason: Count by non-overlapping fragments. The left heteroaromatic ring plus the central aromatic fused part is counted as 11 unique heavy-atom bonds: 6 bonds around the left ring, and because the central ring shares one edge with the left ring, it only additionally adds 5 bonds. The right bridged-ring amine system, without repeatedly counting the already counted aromatic fused edge and excluding the external hydroxyl side chain, adds another 8 heavy-atom bonds. The hydroxyl side chain on nitrogen adds 2 heavy-atom bonds, namely N–C and C–O; O–H is not counted. The total is 11 + 8 + 2 = 21.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible skeleton, then count bonds by non-overlapping fragments. Count the fused left heteroaromatic + central aromatic portion as 11 unique heavy-atom bonds: 6 around the left ring plus 5 additional bonds from the central ring because one edge is shared. Then count the right bridged amine ring system, excluding the already-counted aromatic fusion edge and excluding the external hydroxy side chain, as 8 additional heavy-atom bonds. Finally count the side chain attached to nitrogen as 2 heavy-atom bonds: N–C and C–O; exclude O–H. Sum 11 + 8 + 2 = 21.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧可见含两个氮原子的杂芳环与中间芳香环稠合；右侧可见与该芳香部分相连/稠合的桥环胺结构，胺氮再向右连到一个含羟基的侧链。图中有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头；氢相关的键也不计。
再推理：按非重叠片段计数。左侧杂芳环加中央芳香稠合部分计为11个唯一重原子键：左环环周6个键，中央环因与左环共享一条边，只额外增加5个键。右侧桥环胺体系在不重复计算已计入的芳香稠合边、且不包括外部羟基侧链的情况下，再增加8个重原子键。氮上的羟基侧链增加2个重原子键，即N–C和C–O；O–H不计。总数为11 + 8 + 2 = 21。
